notablePrerequisites:
You have the largest library size.
At least two of your opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
description:
Activate Temple Bell by tapping it, causing each player to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers for each opponent.
Resolve all Smothering Tithe triggers, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Temple Bell.
Repeat.
